name: Idealist
notes: Footer language switcher offers English and Español. Homepage describes employers and groups posting jobs. A menu lists API and CSR Partners, but the pages behind them could not be opened (404 on guessed URLs), so api_status and partner_program are not confirmed. Site describes itself as a 501(c)(3) based in New York and says it merged with VolunteerMatch; no parent company is named.

review.note: Homepage and about page read; API and CSR Partners pages returned 404 on guessed URLs, and the about page names no parent.

sources.title: Idealist homepage
sources.quote: Connecting more than 200,000 organizations with millions of people looking for social-impact jobs and volunteer opportunities
